what: Let the refused-functions error list every function when asked. refused_error (crates/blaze-cargo/src/lib.rs:32-51) names only the first REFUSED_SHOWN = 16 and then says "and N more", and nothing can raise that. Make the limit part of a typed input, for example a field on the build request (a CLI flag `--refused all|N` that fills it), not a hidden env var. The default stays 16. Why: to count hello's refusals by cause, builder-2 has had to rebuild blaze with a local edit raising the constant to 100_000 (56 refusals today, 238 earlier).

history.note: blaze --refused N|all (build, check, run, test, bench; blaze-only, stripped from cargo args) fills blaze_api::Cargo::refused: Option<u32> (None = every function; CLI default Some(16)); SCHEMA 18 -> 19. Daemon: JobInput.refused (agent requests: Some(16)), compile.rs passes it to refused_error and hashes it into the unit work key (a refused unit record is replayed). Also edited blaze-api lib.rs + identity.rs and fuzz/targets/api_envelope.rs (Cargo literals). Docs: cargo.md, no-rustc.md. Tests: cli/args/tests.rs refused_is_blazes_a_count_or_all, lib.rs a_refused_error_names_as_many_as_asked. rust-analyzer 0 errors.
